hypothesis: Ideal encoder-learning gains may not survive finite measurements. Test frozen,validation-selected encoders with correct shared-basis outcome covariance.
design: Models35/refinements37 frozen;5 seeds,4 tasks,512 new test points,1024/4096 total shots per prediction,10 measurement repeats. Four local bases per encoding scale.
fairness: Same total shots for fixed/learned encoders,including all views and bases. No gate noise; ideal training may exploit features that are hard to measure.
selection: All checkpoint choices already fixed; no use of this test for model tuning.
